briefdescription.para: Shared base for session/token managers offering session-table and JWT helpers.

detaileddescription.para: This header declares KeeprBase, a base class holding the database and JWT code that both SessionManager and TokenManager need. It can read and update session rows, format UTC timestamps, fetch password hashes, and decode/verify JWTs. It keeps a cached copy of the token parameters (including the signing secret) and reaches the database through a shared DatabaseController, so derived managers reuse the same connection pool rather than opening their own.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: SessionManager and TokenManager both need to touch the session tables and both need to reason about JWTs. Instead of duplicating that SQL and JWT logic, they inherit these helpers from KeeprBase. GateKeeper calls those managers, which call these helpers. Without this shared base, the same session-table mapping and token-verification rules would be copy-pasted in two places and could drift apart. The class is abstract-ish (meant to be inherited), and its members are protected so only derived managers can use them.
